messages:
alex: T-20 until change window 22:00 UTC. Hush protocol on: no merges, exec-only hotfix, snapshot + pin before we touch traffic.

priya: Runbook checked. I have console + incident doc open. Nate is rollback owner, Jamie is metrics lead.

jamie: @deploy-bot pin v2026.03.21-rc5 -> production (api, embeddings, worker)

deploy-bot: Command received: `/pin v2026.03.21-rc5 -> production (api, embeddings, worker)`. Pins applied to 4 groups. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Backup snapshot created snap-1725551234 (for rollback): snap-rl-20260321-172555

nate: Rollback short-steps (if triggered):
1) `/pin v2026.03.18`
2) `/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings,worker --reason "pilot anomalies"`
3) `/db revert --tag 20260318_safe` (if migrations involved)

nate: Pasteable snippet:
```
/pin v2026.03.18
/deploy rollback --groups api,embeddings,worker --reason "pilot anomalies"
/db revert --tag 20260318_safe
```

jamie: Pilot slice set to 4% traffic, label pilot=v2026.03.21-rc5. Monitoring p95 <130ms, user error <0.25%.

alex: Ramp plan: 4% for 12m -> 20% for 15m -> 80% -> 100%. Quiet period: freeze +2h after final rollout.

priya: Alert triggers: if user-facing errors >0.5% for 3m OR p95 >250ms for 5m, we roll back immediately.

deploy-bot: Pilot start confirmed at 22:04 UTC. Traffic snapshot: total 68k/min, pilot ~2.7k/min.

jamie: Seeing a small tail-latency bump on pilot node set-2, pulling logs now `/logs set-2`.

nate: I recommend cache-prefetch tweak on pilot pods. Quick command applied to pilot group.

jamie: After tweak p95 dropped back to 110ms, error rate 0.08%. Holding roll.

alex: Proceed slow ramp to 20% in 10m if metrics stay stable. Keep all commands and timings in this thread for postmortem.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% complete at 22:20 UTC.

priya: No further anomalies. Proceed to 80% per plan.

deploy-bot: Full rollout complete at 22:37 UTC. Release state: `v2026.03.21-rc5 -> production (api, embeddings, worker)`. :tada:

alex: Exec confirmed freeze lift at 00:10 UTC. Closing thread — follow-up doc to capture cache change, pilot timeline, and rollback checklist for postmortem.
